AllPossibleOptions.rationale: presentation only: Darv.cs:73-74 flattens every relic in _validRelicSets plus Dusty Tome for the run-history / compendium listing. It is not consulted when the options are generated (GenerateInitialOptions builds its own list) and has no game-state reader.

guards.what: _validRelicSets (Darv.cs:48-67): 7 unconditional single-relic sets (Astrolabe, Black Star, Calling Bell, Empty Cage, Pandora's Box, Runic Pyramid, Snecko Eye), one act-2 pair (Ectoplasm | Sozu) and one act-3 pair (Philosopher's Stone | Velvet Choker)
guards.maps_to: events/darv.py:27-37 _RELIC_SETS in source order with the same act filters (act_index 1 and 2). All nine sets and all eleven relics present, in the source's order -- which matters because the order is the input to the UnstableShuffle.

guards.what: GenerateInitialOptions (Darv.cs:167-188): one base.Rng.NextItem per passing set, UnstableShuffle the picks, then a NextBool -- true takes the first 2 and appends Dusty Tome, false takes the first 3
guards.maps_to: events/darv.py:51-64 (the parity branch) reproduces all four steps on self.event_rng in order: next_item per set (single-relic sets still burn a draw, matching NextItem on a 1-element array), shuffle, next_bool, then the 2+Tome / 3 split. This unit is one of the six that DOES have a parity branch, so EV-3 does not apply to it.

guards.what: DustyTome.SetupForPlayer before the option is offered (Darv.cs:176-181)
guards.maps_to: events/darv.py:75-86 _dusty_tome_option: make_relic('dusty_tome') then tome.setup_for_player(run), so the Ancient card it will grant is fixed when the option appears -- the same pre-roll the source does.

events/darv.py:17-18 records the filter as always-true and _RELIC_SETS:32 gives Pandora's Box no filter. EXECUTED rather than assumed is not needed here: the sim has no ModifierModel port at all (`grep -rn ClearsPlayerDeck sts2_rl` is empty), so no ported modifier can clear the deck and the filter is the identity. Recorded so a future modifier port is caught.
events/ancient.py:24-32 heals max_hp - hp on begin(), the shared between-acts heal. Plain CreatureCmd.Heal on the C# side, no hooks.
